description: Lists the current offers and packages (for example ski packages or summer escapes): id, title, short text, what is included, season, house and the offer page URL. Prices depend on dates: use check_availability or send the guest to the offer page.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

season.description: Only winter or summer offers, or all.

name: list_offers

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.

title: Offers and packages
